metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task lets QNN classes infer parameters from QNNCircuit, so correctness is mainly circuit-wrapper compatibility.

task.problem_statement: The repository already provides SamplerQNN and EstimatorQNN implementations that operate on parameterized circuits, and it also provides QNNCircuit as a higher-level wrapper around feature-map and ansatz circuits. However, users still had to manually pass separate input and weight parameter lists when constructing SamplerQNN or EstimatorQNN, even when those parameters were already tracked by a QNNCircuit. The QNN interfaces should accept QNNCircuit directly and infer the required parameter lists from it.
requirements: SamplerQNN must accept a QNNCircuit as its circuit argument and derive input_params from the QNNCircuit input parameters.
SamplerQNN must derive weight_params from the QNNCircuit weight parameters when a QNNCircuit is provided.
EstimatorQNN must accept a QNNCircuit as its circuit argument and derive input_params from the QNNCircuit input parameters.
EstimatorQNN must derive weight_params from the QNNCircuit weight parameters when a QNNCircuit is provided.
Constructing either QNN from an equivalent manually composed circuit with explicit parameters or from a QNNCircuit must produce matching parameter properties.
Forward and backward evaluations for the QNNCircuit-based construction must match the equivalent manually composed circuit construction.

interface.Name: QNNCircuit
interface.Input: constructor: num_qubits: int | None = None, feature_map=None, ansatz=None
interface.Description: Circuit wrapper exposing feature-map input parameters and ansatz weight parameters for QNN construction.

interface.Name: SamplerQNN
interface.Input: constructor: circuit: QuantumCircuit | QNNCircuit, sampler=None, input_params=None, weight_params=None, sparse: bool = False, interpret=None, output_shape=None, gradient=None, input_gradients: bool = False
interface.Description: Sampler-based neural network whose constructor accepts QNNCircuit, infers input_params and weight_params from it, and exposes sparse, output_shape, num_inputs, num_weights, and input_gradients behavior.

interface.Name: SamplerQNN.forward
interface.Description: Evaluates the sampler neural network forward pass for explicit circuits and QNNCircuit-based construction.

interface.Name: SamplerQNN.backward
interface.Description: Evaluates the sampler neural network backward pass for explicit circuits and QNNCircuit-based construction.

interface.Name: EstimatorQNN
interface.Input: constructor: circuit: QuantumCircuit | QNNCircuit, estimator=None, observables=None, input_params=None, weight_params=None, gradient=None, input_gradients: bool = False
interface.Description: Estimator-based neural network whose constructor accepts QNNCircuit, infers input_params and weight_params from it, and exposes circuit, observables, and input_gradients behavior.

interface.Name: EstimatorQNN.forward
interface.Description: Evaluates the estimator neural network forward pass for explicit circuits and QNNCircuit-based construction.

interface.Name: EstimatorQNN.backward
interface.Description: Evaluates the estimator neural network backward pass for explicit circuits and QNNCircuit-based construction.
